title: the host commands bring their own environment
note: lane H's card H-88 (high-risk); the bench's install walk, step 8, 2026-11-22

findings.claim: the restore drill typed with the host's python3 stops on a module the host lacks (zstandard, cryptography, psycopg): shown on the H-84 base by the sudo-typed bare test
findings.expected: the drill runs as RUNBOOK 5 writes it

findings.claim: sudo drops TB_DB_URL, so the restore drill refused at once; the tool now reads the box's deploy/.env
findings.expected: the drill finds the database names on the box

findings.claim: the scheduled backup run from cron's bare environment stops on No module named 'tb_common' (the bench's step 8)
findings.happened: backup failed: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tb_common'

findings.claim: model status and omop-store need psycopg and mail needs the gateway's code: on the host's python3 each stopped on ModuleNotFoundError
findings.expected: each runs in the box image

findings.claim: plain trialbox doctor on the host's python3 reports check error ModuleNotFoundError for its checks that import pydantic, criteria_compiler or psycopg
findings.happened: check error: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pydantic'

findings.claim: restore in the box image cannot ask docker compose which services run (D-724) or run TB_DB_ROLES_CMD: it refuses unless --services-stopped
findings.expected: restore on a box as RUNBOOK 5 writes it

findings.claim: a missing input file of backup-check, backup-verify or backup --public ends in a traceback, not a sentence
